title: Prove the exact regrading bound on the rebuilt 677-owner BIT graph
body:
Projecting native port 89 and helper 660 changes the actual cochart quotient from 656 to 659 components. With the surviving packet equations and nesting fixed, the global rational-chart optimum has complete signed change at most −23.032280834642647 at the first trial. Explicit rational frames attain the directed ceiling within 5e−25. The 677 surviving forward and adjoint rows match.

## Task and overlap

The fixed-quotient bound #7979 `5a0a5c252cc05a246a557ff18b63e9f23400eff9` kept the original cochart unions. This follow-up rebuilds those unions directly from the projected packet forms. #7983 `5f393bfc838276228ff8adfee9c5625d8ce9197f` assumes the original graph and anchors. The zero-rank compiler boundary is tracked separately in #7980. The scoped task is the #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, based on `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive gives exact source identities and complete assumptions.

## Validation

Validate SHA256SUMS and run the README commands in a clean Python 3.12 extraction. All six scientific receipts reproduced. A separate BFS and rational price/geometry checker independently verifies 893 dimension assignments, 509 feasible rational cases, both native operators, and 94 exact projector edge relations.

## Open next questions

Test a changed surviving packet equation, a reroute or reversed nesting, or a different owner projection. A new literal physical supplier, owned erasure, finite precision and complete application require separate evidence.
